criteria.requirement: Extend actual compiler common import path for import/from to use Environment.get_or_select_template, preserving existing cache/module/context behavior. Accept static or dynamic ordered candidates, select first existing template and expose TemplatesNotFound for empty/all missing; an existing selected template syntax error or missing requested macro must never be swallowed as a reason to choose another candidate. Preserve string imports, aliasing, with/without context and asynchronous module handling through the actual render APIs.
